doubleClickLogin: Inputs and button were usable before client hydration, so the first interaction could be lost or read empty React state.
router.replace('/portal') was immediately followed by router.refresh(), creating a redirect/session refresh race.
slowLogin: Login flow was followed by a blocking portal sync across eight backend endpoints.
slowNavigation: PortalShellV2 blocked protected pages while PortalProvider waited for all backend sync endpoints.

login: Disable login fields and button until hydration is complete.
Use controlled form submit with preventDefault.
Refetch session after sign-in, then navigate once to /portal.
Remove immediate router.refresh after router.replace in the login success path.
portalSync: Block initial shell only on /api/users and /api/settings/module-visibility.
Load letters, dispositions, AI settings, WhatsApp settings, institution settings, and assistant judge settings in the background.
Use cached actor state for non-blocking refresh when a server-verified session already exists.

after.note: Development cold compile/restart remained noisy and was not treated as application auth latency.

testsAdded: login submits once, refetches session, and navigates without router.refresh race
login with incomplete credentials shows a human-readable error
residualRisks: Next.js development cold compile can still be slow.
/api/surat still performs disposition-based access filtering and may deserve later query optimization.
